spiritgiven.comments: On double teaming and fast counts the stall was never dropped. Despite numerous calls for fouls and body contact, we felt this did not improve throughout the game.There were multiple examples of bad attitude. There were many spikes of the disc after scoring even after speaking to your coaches. We were made to wait for captains as you were 'finishing a drill' limiting our warm up. One player made a rude gesture when making a call which got a rise out of your sideline and coaches.
There were a few instances of a lack of Rules knowledge and use specifically when calling in or out - only one foot needs to be down and in not both. Otherwise a really enjoyable match!
A very intense last game and any contact was mutual and communication was great. Just be careful on how you set your defense as it caused loads of picks.

spiritreceived.comments: Thanks for the game, the communication both on and off the field and of course hosting this WJUC :)

Communication was good at the beginning of the game but i got worse at the end expecially with the coaches and couple of players wich also weren’t really calm while talking to us, but still a nice and intense match!
There were several foul calls but all were resolved quickly and with fair-mindedness.
Communication was great, and a clean game! Thanks GB
Good game, communication was great, very nice team!
It was a good game including the plays and the spirits. When someone in our team was fell down, somebody in your team did care us and that was a good spirit! Thank you for the hard game!
Nice, clean game. Kept fighting till the end. Overall, good spirit and an enjoyable game.

Thank you for this very intense and fun last game! For the next time we’d appreciate calls being made on the field and not from the sideline as well as sticking to the time limits (that’s why 1 on rules knowledge and use), but we loved your power and loud sideline even though it was the last game. Congratulations and see you next year at Europeans :))
